title: Harden release package gates and package-scope validation
summary: Implements confirmed release/package gate findings from the release-package review packet, including personal-config zip prevention, PG3 report ignore hygiene, release traversal pruning, package-scope exclusions, and recursive Tauri asset syntax coverage.
reason: Release packaging is a no-touch boundary because accidental live config, logs, state, personal paths, stale launchers, or unvalidated package behavior can ship private operator data or unverifiable artifacts.
behavior_before: KeepPersonalConfig could be combined with Zip; PG3 reports were package-excluded but not gitignored; release build enumerated excluded trees before applying policy; Tauri JS syntax checks were non-recursive; package-scope helpers only modeled omitted tests.
behavior_after: Release builder rejects zipped personal mirrors, prunes unconditional excluded directories before traversal, PG3 reports are ignored by Git/search rules, package-scope helpers model always-omitted and optional package omissions, and the Tauri build checker recurses through nested WebView JavaScript assets.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1: personal-config zip rejection, pruned release traversal, PG3 ignore-rule assertions
manual_validation: Read AGENTS.md, docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/OPEN_WORK_CHECKLIST.md, docs/generated/PROJECT_INDEX.md, and docs/operator/NO_TOUCH_BOUNDARY_REGISTER.md before source edits.
Ingested the provided release/package review artifacts from the external review workspace and verified each Markdown claim against current source before changing release/package files.
Verified RPG-001 as invalid for current source: active release-foundation docs and MP-CHANGE-2026-0615-013 require Tauri semver 6.0.0 while the backend release label remains 2026.06.04.001.
Redacted a validation-discovered local workstation path from unrelated in-progress change packet MP-CHANGE-2026-0615-022.json because it blocked the release package local-path leak gate.
